assessment.evidence_origin: exact released CPO implementation plus clean-worker source-equivalent algebraic validation
assessment.claim_scope: CPO mask_loss logging aggregation algebra under the released ZeRO-3 partition logic and source-equivalent synthetic partitioning
basis: At MaolinLuo/CPO commit 9429452cb536a9e713b73b91c0011b96df44962c, src/trainer/grpo_trainer_cl.py computes ZeRO-3 mask_loss_value from each rank's local partition while normalizing tensor contributions by the global protected-support count, gathers the resulting scalar, and logs nanmean; the released source comment states the exact total would be nansum.

The sealed clean-worker validation result at blob efe133375c4cc1c1a777d2defa9b6cbfb977ea32 exercised 600 source-equivalent ZeRO-3 synthetic cases across world sizes 1/2/3/4/8/16. nansum matched the direct full metric in 600/600 at tolerance 1e-10 with maximum absolute error 5.684341886080802e-14; released nanmean matched full_metric/world_size in 600/600; the unsharded/ZeRO-2 mean path had zero mismatches.
The result directly supports the branch-specific logging inference: sum rank-local partials for sharded ZeRO-3 and retain mean for replicated ZeRO-2/unsharded data parallelism.
scope_guard: The validation used torch 2.10.0+cpu and source-equivalent partitioning; it is not pinned PyTorch 2.8.0 + DeepSpeed 0.16.4 distributed execution evidence.
It does not establish actual historical TensorBoard mask_loss values or their operational impact.
It does not validate or change the separate owner-only training-gradient world-size scaling issue.
The clean-worker validation is not an independent external replication of the runtime behavior.
assessment.strength_reasoning: Primary-source code makes the aggregation semantics directly inspectable, and the deterministic 600-case algebraic validation strongly corroborates the exact mathematical consequence. The absence of pinned distributed-runtime execution and independent replication prevents an A-range upgrade, so B+ remains the strongest supported tier at this exact scope.
